//: //  Martins Over the Bluegrass — Vercel Static Hosting Configuration
//  Optimized for fast, clean, production-grade deployment of a single-page
//   • Strong security headers (X-Content-Type-Options, frame protection, etc.)
//   • Long-term immutable caching for images (best performance for photos)
//   • Conservative caching for HTML so updates are visible quickly
//   • Catch-all rewrite so direct navigation / refresh never 404s
//     (harmless for this hash-based single-page site; assets still served first)
//   • No build step — pure static files served instantly by Vercel's edge
//   • Connect repo to Vercel → it will auto-detect static output
//   • After first deploy, update the placeholder domain in index.html
//     (og:url, canonical, og/twitter:image absolute URLs) for perfect social cards.

headers.//: Global security headers for every response
Aggressive, immutable cache for all images — they almost never change
This is one of the highest-impact performance wins for a photo-heavy site
HTML should be revalidated quickly so content updates appear fast
Also apply reasonable cache to the root path (serves index.html)

rewrites.//: Serve index.html for any path that doesn't match a real file.
This guarantees zero 404s on refresh, direct links, or mistyped paths.
Static assets (/images/*, etc.) are still served exactly by Vercel before rewrites.
Safe and recommended for single-file static marketing sites.
